text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has come, and it's a time
for
growing Umamusume to make leaps
and bounds
in their abilities.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But for some reason, the camp
atmosphere is
causing Мэдзиро Райан to act
strangely.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
While dealing with these more personal

challenges, Ryan also gets a refreshing
break
after a series of tough races.
